Maria (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the post-launch iteration approach for launch-alpha. customer asks + telemetry both flag problems. proposing we prioritize fixes first (roughly 60% bug / 40% enhancements) for next 2 sprints. any objections?
Dan (Eng): sounds reasonable. can you share the top 5 customer-reported regressions so we can scope effort?
Emily (Data): pulled numbers — top 5 by impact: streaming timeout (p50 latency +120ms), embedding mismatch for 3 customers, chat rerank incorrect ordering, one memory leak on p99, CSV export corruption edge-case.
Raj (Support): the CSV export and embedding mismatch are blocking two enterprise customers (legal review held up). others are high friction but not blocking yet.
Sasha (Design): a few of the enhancements are tiny (text truncation UX, button label). we can batch those into a quick polish sprint if engineering capacity allows.
Maria (PM): propose triage criteria: 1) user-blocking or contract/regulatory impact = must fix; 2) regression vs pre-launch baseline = high priority; 3) customer SLA/business impact = high; 4) low-effort UX wins = candidate for parallel mini-sprint.
Dan (Eng): ok. for triage we should auto-surface regressions with this query: ```label:postlaunch AND (regression OR crash OR data-loss) AND severity>=P2``` put into triage board.
Emily (Data): added severity and affected-customer columns to the board. also computed estimated dev cost for top 5: total ~6 dev-weeks.
Maria (PM): given cost, plan: Sprint A (2 weeks) = hotfix bundle for top 3 regressions + quick infra patch; Sprint B (2 weeks) = split: 60% bug backlog remaining, 40% enhancement polish batch. if customer A needs a legal-facing fix earlier, we bump that into an out-of-band patch.
Dan (Eng): can we do a canary deploy for the hotfix bundle to US-only customers first? reduces blast radius.
Sasha (Design): for the polish batch I can deliver mocks and microcopy in 3 days.
Raj (Support): I'll prep customer comms drafts and escalation templates. flagging CustomerA & CustomerB for special handling.
Maria (PM): rollout plan: canary → monitor 24h key metrics (error-rate, p99 latency, customer-reported checks) → full rollout if stable. rollback policy: revert to previous model variant + enable cached responses.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window requested for 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (canary).
Dan (Eng): one ask: need freeze on non-critical merges 24h before canary.
Maria (PM): agreed. I'll send calendar block and update the runbook.
Raj (Support): added canned responses and a triage playbook to the board.
Emily (Data): I'll set alerts: streaming-timeout > baseline+50ms, embed-accuracy drop >2% -> paging.
Sasha (Design): quick note: some polish items rely on tiny infra change; I'll flag dependencies on the tickets.
Maria (PM): action items: Dan -> estimate hotfix PRs today; Emily -> attach metric dashboards; Raj -> comms draft; Sasha -> deliver mocks; I'll finalize sprint plan. aim to confirm in 24h. :thumbsup:
Dan (Eng): on it.
Raj (Support): will sync with CustomerA.
Emily (Data): dashboards linked.
Sasha (Design): mocks uploaded to ticket #PL-142.
Maria (PM): thanks — meeting unnecessary unless new blockers pop up.
